summary: Reopening a session shows nothing: load the session's runs and replay the latest run's events
description:
Source: DFMEA 2026-11-04 (F03), and also seen in the team sync: clicking an existing session, or reloading the page, shows an empty chat. Confirmed: there's no `GET /api/sessions/{id}/runs`, and `handleSelectSession` clears state without loading anything.

**Fix:**

* API: `GET /api/sessions/{id}/runs`, newest first.
* UI: on selecting a session (and on page load), load its latest run. Replay `GET /api/runs/{id}/timeline` through the ANVIL-52 render model. If the run is still active, attach the live stream after the last seq.
* Optional: a small run switcher for older runs in the session.

**Acceptance:**

* reloading during a run shows the full conversation so far and keeps streaming;
* opening a finished session shows its last run;
* covered by an e2e test.

comments.body: [claude] Reassigned from cline to devin (11-05 04:22). Cline's worktree has had no change since 00:30 and this is on Friday's critical path: a run started by intake has no UI stream, so the presenter would see nothing live until the session is reopened with its timeline and the stream reattached. Remaining on PR #79 (cline's branch, 2 commits in): App.tsx passes the timeline's last seq as `afterSeq` for an active run; an App.test.tsx case for a finished run and for the active-run attach (no repeated seq); the 409-safe backend test; the error banner placement. Cline moves to ANVIL-45.

[claude] Merged as 4b7af29 (PR #79: cline's endpoint and `afterSeq` option, finished by devin after reassignment; claude approved on ce40592, CI green). Stays In Progress until the dry run, because one acceptance bullet is not met as written.

Met:

* **Reloading during a run shows the conversation so far and keeps streaming:** `App.test.tsx` "an active run reattaches at the last seq and shows no duplicate" (timeline loaded, stream reattached with `Last-Event-ID` = last seq, the resent event is deduped by seq). Backed by the user-scoped `GET /api/sessions/{id}/runs` (newest first, 404 for unknown; `test_list_runs_for_session_newest_first`, which lets each run finish first because of the one-active-run rule).
* **Opening a finished session shows its last run:** "selecting a session whose latest run finished shows its You message".
* Race found in review and fixed with a test: switching sessions while an attach is in flight can no longer overwrite the newer session's chat or stream.

Not met: "covered by an e2e test". These are component tests with mocked `fetch`, not a browser against a live API. The real proof is the 15:00 dry run (row "an intake-started run shows up live" is being added to `docs/dry-run-checklist.md`): start a run from a ticket in `todo/`, reload the UI after intake has picked it up, select the session, and confirm the chat shows the run so far with no event twice and that it keeps streaming. I will close this ticket on that evidence, or on a Playwright test if one is written.

Related and done: ANVIL-96 (#108) for the approvals panel refresh.
